thesis: The page is a sheet of traditional flash under glass: every answer the shop gives is lettered on a tattoo banner ribbon, and the ribbons unfurl as you read, so prices, hours and healing days arrive the way flash names do.

signature.name: Flash Banner Ribbon
signature.summary: One SVG primitive: a 3px black-outlined traditional tattoo banner ribbon with folded swallowtail ends carrying one League Gothic line; --sw-p unfurls it from the center and flips the ends open. Hero ribbon across the h1 tile (trade + city), code ribbons on the flash rail that flip to size words, day-marker ribbons along the tide-line healing timeline, the cover-up answer on a red ribbon, name ribbons over review notes, the guarantee on a mustard ribbon, and the footer's big hours ribbon tucked behind the drawn harbor crane.

palette.family: Sun-Faded Flash: Sea Teal + Flash Red + Mustard + Sheet Cream

layoutMoves: Flash-wall field: sun-faded teal ground with cream sheets hung at fixed small tilts (desktop only, 0deg under 640px) and ink offset shadows
Horizontal flash rail >=1024px (pinned slide of 6 drawn flash sheets), 2-col stacked grid on phones
Tide-line divider: a drawn wave horizon splits teal from cream and carries the healing-day ribbons
Hero mosaic where half the tiles are information (price, hours, place) and only one or two are photos

motion.intro: Mosaic tiles pin up with a 60ms stagger (rotate 2deg to 0, rise 12px, 520ms), then the hero ribbon unfurls from its center and its ends flip open; under 1.1s, any input skips, content is in the DOM first.
stories: Flash rail (slide): >=1024px six drawn sheets slide along the wall on scroll and each code ribbon flips to its size words as it crosses center; stacked grid below.
Tide line (draw): a wave line draws left to right with scroll and day ribbons 1/3/7/14/21 unfurl as it reaches them, the mustard back-in-the-ocean ribbon last.
motion.hover: The sheet nudge: pinned things rotate -1deg and lift 3px while the ink offset shadow grows 2px to 4px, 200ms ease-out, hover devices only.
